OLF Course Rules Beachline Departure, Aransas Co/Rockport
Beachline Departure:
Runway Departures:
Abeam High Bridge:
Aransas County
Arrival Procedures
North MUSTANG/South-North Transition:
Execute area exit/transition procedures.
Radio Calls:
“Corpus Approach, (call sign), Over Woodsboro, course rules Aransas County.”
Contact Departure when directed
Contact CRP Approach if proceeding South
If proceeding to the North, contact Houston Center and request flight following
Must be cleared by tower prior, when directed:
preferred method over course rules to Shamrock when aircrews are forced to return to KNGP with the landing gear or flaps extended.
Use Zulu time
Exercise caution when descending to initial due to potential traffic at 1500' MSL.
Coordinate with Corpus Approach if climbing above 4500' MSL for High-Key.
If there's doubt on civilian aircraft's understanding, reset to High-Key and clarify intentions.
YOU ARE CONSIDERED ESTABLISHED ON COURSE RULES ARRIVAL WHEN YOU ARE RADAR IDENTIFIED WITH APPROACH AND THEY HAVE INSTRUCTED YOU TO FLY COURSE RULES.
IF UNABLE TO MAINTAIN VMC, SQUAWK 7600 AND COMPLY WITH IFR LOST COMMUNICATION PROCEDURES.
THESE PROCEDURES SHOULD NOT PRECLUDE EXERCISING SOUND JUDGEMENT IN WHATEVER ACTION A PILOT ELECTS TO TAKE. (AIM, FAR 91.185)
